local p = {}
local h = {}

function p.query(query)
	local copyQuery = mw.clone(query)
	if type(copyQuery.tables) == 'table' then
		copyQuery.tables = table.concat(copyQuery.tables, ',')
	end
	if type(copyQuery.fields) == 'table' then
		copyQuery.fields = table.concat(copyQuery.fields, ',')
	end
	if type(copyQuery.join) == 'table' then
		copyQuery.join = table.concat(copyQuery.join, ',')
	end
	if type(copyQuery.where) == 'table' then
		copyQuery.where = p.concatWhere(copyQuery.where)
	end
	local result = mw.ext.cargo.query(
		copyQuery.tables,
		copyQuery.fields,
		copyQuery
	)
	return result
end

-- after query

function p.groupResultByValue(result, key, f)
	local data = {}
	for _, row in ipairs(result) do
		local thisValue = row[key]
		if thisValue ~= nil then
			if not data[thisValue] then
				data[thisValue] = { name = thisValue }
			end
			local thisTab = data[thisValue]
			thisTab[#thisTab+1] = f and f(row) or row
		end
	end
	return data
end

function p.store(row)
	local title = mw.title.getCurrentTitle()
	if CARGO_NAMESPACE and title.nsText ~= CARGO_NAMESPACE then
		return
	end
	if not row then return end
	local row2 = { '' }
	for k, v in pairs(row) do
		if type(v) == 'boolean' then
			row2[k] = v and 'Yes' or 'No'
		else
			row2[k] = v
		end
	end
	mw.getCurrentFrame():callParserFunction('#cargo_store', row2)
	return
end

function p.storeAndAttach(row)
	p.store(row)
	mw.getCurrentFrame():expandTemplate{
		title = ('%s/CargoAttach'):format(row._table),
		args = {}
	}
end

function p.setStoreNamespace(ns)
	CARGO_NAMESPACE = ns
end

function p.concatWhere(tbl)
	local arr = {}
	for _, v in pairs(tbl) do
		if v then
			arr[#arr+1] = ('(%s)'):format(v)
		end
	end
	if #arr == 0 then return nil end
	return ('(%s)'):format(table.concat(arr, ' AND '))
end

return p
